name: quick-entry-card
title: S8 快捷入口卡 (QuickEntryCard)
description: 快捷入口卡（S8 · 尺寸 S）— 图标底 · 标题 · 跳转箭头

files.content: import * as React from 'react' import { ArrowUpRight, TerminalWindow } from '@phosphor-icons/react' import { IconTile } from '@/components/ui/icon-tile' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { HUE_PALETTES, TILE_THEMES, type Hue, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface QuickEntryCardProps { title: string subtitle: string icon?: React.ReactNode tone?: TileTone href?: string onClick?: () => void } export function QuickEntryCard({ title, subtitle, icon, tone = 'sky-dark', href, onClick, }: QuickEntryCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] const iconHue = tone in HUE_PALETTES ? (tone as Hue) : theme.dark ? 'dark-glass' : 'sky' return ( {icon ?? } {title} {subtitle} ) }
